# ClearStack

> Structured web design and AI automation for NZ small businesses.

ClearStack is a solo web development and AI automation studio based in Auckland, New Zealand, founded by Ben Price. We build business websites, landing pages, web applications, and AI-powered automation tools for New Zealand small businesses.

## Services

- **Business websites** — Custom React/Next.js websites, up to 6 pages, from $3,500 NZD
- **Landing pages** — Single-purpose conversion pages, from $1,200 NZD
- **Web applications** — Custom tools, portals, dashboards built with React and Next.js
- **AI agents & automation** — Workflow automation, lead follow-up, document processing, AI-powered tools

## Technology

All work is built with React and Next.js. Content-managed sites use Sanity CMS. Hosting is typically on Vercel.

## Location & Contact

- Based in Auckland, New Zealand
- Serves clients across New Zealand (remote-friendly)
- Email: hello@clearstack.nz
- Website: https://clearstack.nz

## Pricing

Fixed-price, scoped upfront. No hourly billing.

- Landing page: from $1,200 NZD (one-off)
- Business website: from $3,500 NZD (one-off)
- Web app / AI tool: custom quote

## Process

1. Discovery call — understand goals and requirements
2. Fixed-price proposal — clear scope, timeline, and cost
3. Build — React/Next.js, completed layer by layer
4. Launch & automate — deployment, handover, automation setup

## About

ClearStack is a boutique studio focused on doing one project at a time properly, rather than juggling many clients at once. The approach is structured and methodical — agency-quality output without agency overhead.
